messages:
Ivy (CS): Quick flag from NovaClinic onboarding this AM  three consistent asks from finance, security, and mobile. tagging @Priya @Zane

Priya (Product): paste the asks + any verbatim lines pls. rough priority ok.

Ivy (CS): TL;DR: (A) per-feature cost allocation in Console (not just exports) so teams can charge features to cost centers; (B) department-level model gating (allow admins to gate/un-gate specific model variants per department); (C) streaming client: resume with preserved context + exponential backoff (avoid full session reset on flaky mobile).

Zane (PM): initial read: C is a reliability win we can try next sprint; A is medium (backend + UI); B is larger (access controls + audit + policy).

Connor (AE): renewal 2026-01-18. NovaClinic said procurement will stall unless they can show chargeback per feature and department.

Ivy (CS): short snippet I pulled from notes with customer wording:

Ivy (CS): ```
customer,ask,impact,quote
NovaClinic,feature_chargeback,procurement needs cost lines,"We must show spend per feature to bill internal departments"
NovaClinic,dept_model_gating,security needs control,"Security needs to gate unvetted variants per department"
NovaClinic,stream_resume,devs need stateful reconnect,"On spotty LTE the session restarts and we lose the conversation state"
```

summarizer-bot: Auto-summary tags [feature_chargeback, dept_model_gating, stream_resume]. Linked ticket PROD-Triage-2110.

Zane (PM): I'll open PROD-Triage-2110 and propose priorities: stream_resume -> P1, feature_chargeback -> P2, dept_model_gating -> P3. will add rough estimates after scoping.

Priya (Product): please add to roadmap sync and ask Ivy for one-paragraph customer brief + one example invoice row before we scope. if model gating moves forward we will coordinate legal/security.

Connor (AE): i'll prepare a renewal note for CSM and flag budget sensitivity.

Ivy (CS): action items: Ivy collect invoice example + brief; Zane open ticket; Priya to review legal/security if needed; Connor prep renewal note. looping back with artifacts. :thumbsup:
